description: You are a radiologist performing a cross-modality imaging correlation for a patient who has both a CT scan and an MRI. The CT is already loaded in Weasis from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/crossmod_ct/ and a second MR dataset is available at /home/ga/DICOM/studies/crossmod_mr/. Load both datasets into Weasis for simultaneous comparison. Identify a common anatomical structure visible on both modalities, measure it on each using appropriate window settings, and calculate the inter-modality measurement difference. Also perform a bone-window assessment on the CT. Export annotated views from both modalities as /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ct_crossmod.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/mr_crossmod.png. Write a comparative imaging report to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/crossmodality_report.txt with measurements from both modalities, the percentage difference, and commentary on the relative diagnostic advantages of CT versus MR for the structures assessed.

metadata.clinical_scenario: Cross-modality CT vs MR imaging correlation and comparison
